verdict.rationale: Skyfire's docs say its tokens conform to the open KYAPay protocol, an industry specification at KYAPay.org, so the token format is published as open. However, the same docs note that charging, wallets and settlement run through Skyfire's own key-gated APIs. Only the credential layer, not the full commerce flow, is shown as an open protocol. missing for 10: evidence the spec is versioned, evidence it can be read and implemented without any agreement or signup, an open specification for the charge/settlement layer, and independent or hands-on confirmation of the published spec.

support.subject: As a developer, the commerce protocol this product speaks is published as an open, versioned specification I can read and implement without signing anything

citations.quote: All Skyfire-issued tokens conform to the open KYAPay protocol, an industry specification for identity-linked payment credentials purpose-built for autonomous systems.
